changes.summary: Introduce experimental notion-export: export a public Notion page (URL, UUID or page ID, no token) to Markdown and script-free HTML with local CSS and CSP, page.json and a versioned manifest; ask/yes/no download policy per asset type after 1-byte size probes; bounded concurrent downloads with Content-Type, length and stall validation; bounded retries for the unofficial API; staged publication that never replaces an existing export unless --force validates it belongs to the same page, with rollback; --from-json reprocessing.

changes.justification: Adds a private product and an internal safefs.Root.OpenRoot helper; promotes the already-vetted golang.org/x/text to a direct dependency. The public cli Go API, module path and existing products are unchanged.
changes.summary: Discover the new notion-export product and register its fuzz targets.
